plan.summary:
The PR changes `DEFAULT_MODEL` from `model-6-1` to `model-6-2`. Two tests that hardcode the model name are updated to match.

- `src/models.ts`: new default model constant.
- `tests/chat.test.ts` and `tests/summary.test.ts`: expected strings changed to `model-6-2`.
plan.riskRationale: This is a one-line constant change. The tests pass an explicit model, so they do not read the new default. Users of the default model get a different model, which is a small behavior change.
plan.storyArc: The default model constant is renamed. The tests then use the new name in their expected values.

topics.title: Default model becomes model-6-2
topics.narrativeBrief: What default model do callers now get, and how do the tests use the new name? Verify that the tests pass an explicit model and so do not exercise `DEFAULT_MODEL`.
